g.text: Opening `ssh://user@host/path` — resolve, verify, authenticate, read, refresh
OPEN path — the document group's sibling STATs run in parallel
READ the tail first (1 KiB + 64 B)
settled with backoff, kept behind a note
READ × D in flight (C bytes each)
replies in any order → each at its offset
in the preallocated buffer (large text: a pipelined,
FSTAT (a PDF: size + mtime unchanged?) · CLOSE
same IR pipeline + renderers (identical to a local read)
[a target-daemon invalidation (ADR-0035) — else the opt-in :remote :poll-seconds poller]
ONE re-read per path (a change during it: one trailing read)
(an older seq that lands late is dropped)
Secrets are entered and held main-side; they never enter app-db or config.
